name: half-fillet
description: Weld a 1/4 inch fillet along the right half of the near side of the tacked bracket in the horizontal position: from the right end of the joint (the end on the robots' right, the right end in the bench camera's image) to its middle, 3 inches, and fill the crater where you stop. Leave the left half of the joint unwelded. The spray-transfer schedule for 0.035 inch ER70S-6 wire with 90/10 gas is about 500 in/min (12.7 m/min) wire feed at 29 V.
